import html # Example template – replace with the actual one in your project. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html(author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Args: author_name: Name of the post's author. post_title: Headline of the user's post. content: Main text content of the post. post_tags: List of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing the fully escaped and formatted HTML. """ # Escape user‑supplied values to prevent XSS escaped_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) escaped_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Preserve newlines etc. # Build tags string – each tag wrapped in a escaped_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: # Ensure each tag is also escaped safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Populate the template html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=escaped_author, title=escaped_title, content=escaped_content, tags=tags_html ) return html_output.strip()
